stops.note: a thorny shrub (Cnidoscolus quercifolius) covering the Morro da Favela hill at Canudos, in the Bahian backlands, where the army besieged Antônio Conselheiro's settlement in 1896-97
soldiers back from Canudos, promised housing that never came, settled a hill in Rio de Janeiro and called it Morro da Favela; the name spread to every such settlement
used for Brazilian shantytowns; the 2002 film City of God, set in Rio's Cidade de Deus, made the word widely known abroad

current_meaning: an informal settlement or shantytown in Brazil
